title: Pass the new fields into BootReminderReceiver's schedule() call
description: ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule's signature now requires profileId/medicationId/defaultDoseAmount (task-003) -- doseLog.profileId, doseLog.medicationId, and medication.defaultDose are already in scope in this loop, so a reminder re-armed after a reboot still carries enough data for its own notification action button.
acceptance_criteria: The call becomes ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule(appContext, doseLog.id, nextEligible, title, text, doseLog.profileId, doseLog.medicationId, medication.defaultDose)
exact_code: ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule(appContext, doseLog.id, nextEligible, title, text, doseLog.profileId, doseLog.medicationId, medication.defaultDose)
